comments.body: From tooling feedback a_2xOHTiIPT, 2026-11-10: a Codex worker read extras/skill/SKILL.md lines 90-94 ('To compact yourself and carry on, run muster pane compact ...') as applying to any agent, ran it, and got a refusal, since pane compact types /compact for Claude Code only (docs/cli/harnesses.md, 'Compacted when asked'). It spent a turn before falling back on Codex's own compaction. When the skill mentions compaction, say it is Claude Code only for now and that Codex compacts itself; pane compact --help could say the same. Supporting Codex's /compact is codex-and-opencode.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
